rows.business_description:
Raj Technologies Inc. (RTI) is a premier provider of statewide IT staff augmentation and professional staffing services, backed by four decades of proven public sector experience supporting complex, mission critical government initiatives. For nearly four decades, RTI has delivered highly skilled, government experienced professionals who integrate seamlessly into agency teams, accelerate delivery timelines, and ensure continuity across enterprise programs. Our deep understanding of public sector environments, compliance requirements, and statewide systems enables agencies to scale resources quickly while reducing hiring risk and operational disruption.
RTI provides a comprehensive portfolio of staffing solutions across consulting, technical delivery, operations, and executive leadership. We supply IT consultants, subject matter experts, application and software developers, full stack engineers, solution and enterprise architects, cloud engineers, DevOps professionals, cybersecurity analysts, IAM specialists, data analysts, data engineers, database administrators, quality assurance and testing specialists, automation engineers, release managers, UI/UX designers, business analysts, product owners, functional leads, project managers, program managers, PMO professionals, Scrum Masters, Agile coaches, technical writers, trainers, and executive leaders such as CIO advisors, program directors, and transformation leads. This breadth of roles enables RTI to support initiatives from strategy and planning through implementation, operations, and continuous optimization.
RTI has deep staffing expertise supporting Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) initiatives, providing skilled professionals experienced with platforms such as IBM Maximo, Infor EAM, and enterprise maintenance and asset lifecycle systems. Our EAM resources support system implementation, integration, upgrades, data conversion, reporting, and operational support for large transportation authorities, utilities, and infrastructure centric agencies. In parallel, RTI supplies cloud qualified professionals with hands on experience in Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS), supporting cloud architecture, migration, DevOps pipelines, infrastructure automation, security, and ongoing operations in hybrid and multi cloud government environments.
RTI also delivers strong staffing capabilities in IT Networking Solutions, providing network engineers, infrastructure specialists, and security professionals experienced in enterprise network design, LAN/WAN architecture, network modernization, cloud connectivity, endpoint management, and secure government communications. These resources support agencies in building resilient, scalable, and secure network infrastructures aligned with evolving digital and cybersecurity requirements.
RTI’s staff augmentation model is purpose built for government environments, refined through 40 years of recruiting, vetting, and workforce management experience. Every resource undergoes rigorous technical screening, role specific qualification, and reference validation, ensuring alignment with agency standards, security requirements, and enterprise platforms such as ERP systems, EAM, cloud platforms, cybersecurity frameworks, application modernization environments, data and analytics solutions, and infrastructure operations. This disciplined approach significantly reduces onboarding time, improves productivity, and lowers delivery risk.
Beyond placement, RTI provides active workforce management and continuity assurance, including performance oversight, rapid backfill capabilities, and flexible scaling to support both short term surge needs and long term, multi year programs. Agencies benefit from a single, accountable staffing partner with nearly four decades of public sector experience, capable of sustaining complex enterprise initiatives. As a certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) and Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) with access to multiple statewide and multi state contracting vehicles, RTI enables agencies to meet diversity and procurement objectives efficiently while maintaining the highest standards of quality, security, and reliability.

When you’re ready to take hold of your finances, we’ll be ready.

rows.business_description:
DARE Consulting specializes in helping educational leaders develop high-performing team culture among the adults, so that students can thrive. We focus on teaching school and district leaders how to move beyond traditional top-down, compliance management methods which have been shown to lead to conflict, quiet quitting, and bias. Instead, we help leaders develop cutting-edge, human-centered, management techniques that lead to improvements in a range of areas including: employee engagement, innovation, productivity, quality of work, cost savings, and a stronger sense of belonging for all.

We offer three types of services:

1. Cohort Model – This model invites managers from different offices to participate in a workshop series that builds skills in Human-Centered Leadership. The series also offers opportunities for coaching and follow-up support. Some of our key workshops include: creating psychologically safe environments, giving feedback in ways that lead to action, conflict resolution, effective communication, strategic planning and monitoring, collective decision-making, engaging presentations, and more.  

2. Full-Team Transformation – This program engages employees and leaders within a single office to work together to transform their team culture. The approach uses the Kaleidoscope Method, where teams engage in an inquiry-based effort to collect team data, identify points of intervention, set goals, and then work together to achieve those goals. 

3. Research and Communications – This program supports leaders in conducting research to identify what’s working and what’s not in terms of team dynamics. This includes 360 assessments, culture surveys, program evaluation, and other methods. We then work with the leaders to share the information in ways that get senior leaders and employees lit on fire to create change.

rows.business_description:
Approved Electric Corporation is an Electrical Contracting Minority Business Enterprise that has been in operation over eighteen years.  Trevor Dunwell Sr. is the original founder and President of the company, with over 39 years of experience in the construction industry.  

Over the years we have transformed our organization to give our clients quality service through innovative concepts.  Where we are now conducting business Approved Electric has recognized steady growth in their business, and has employed key individuals to maintain competitiveness within their industry.  Unlike many of our competitors, we have been able to recognize positive revenue throughout the economic downturn that has plagued many companies and industries alike.

Approved was able to recognize an increase in profits by expanding their clientele base and building on external and internal core competencies.  Approved Electric no longer focuses business strategy on electrical construction for residential and commercial customers.  Through the years Approved has taken advantage of the rise in the telecommunications industry and has begun to offer installation solutions for their clients.  Approved has also expanded themselves to the high voltage industry in an attempt to work for customers such as Consolidated Edison, and PSE&G where they are aggressively seeking electrical contractors.
Approved Electric started out eighteen years ago offering power, heating and lighting solutions for contractors on small scale jobs for under $50,000.  Today we are a company that provides an array of contractors, business owners, developers, city, state and federal organizations, architects & engineers, public utilities, and residential clients with electrical solutions for jobs ranging from $20,000.00 to $2,000,000.00.  

These customers all look toward Approved Electric to fulfill varying needs which includes the following services;
Lighting Systems   Heating Systems  Power Systems  
Security Systems   Fire Alarm Systems  Control Wiring
Bell Systems    Intercom Wiring  Card Access Systems 
Electrical Renovations  Switches & Outlets  Dedicated Computer Lines
Telecommunication Wiring  Emergency Services  High Tower Lighting
Automatic Transfer Switches  Substation Wiring  Closed Circuit Televisions
Public Address Systems  Sound Systems
Through the years we have been able to build an astounding portfolio of clients that includes both public and private agencies such as:
School Construction Authority    Nextel
Dormitory Authority of the State of New York  Joy Construction
City Housing Authority     Kreisler Borg Florman
Metropolitan Transportation Authority   Turner Construction
New York State Office of General Services   AT&T
SG2 Construction Management    Port Authority on NJ/NY


Approved is looking forward to working with reputable clients that can help us grow as an organization in becoming a recognizable mid-size electrical contracting company in the tri-state area.

rows.business_description:
Dattner Architects is a women-owned business with one office, in New York City. We are a mission-driven firm, committed to enriching civic space and the urban experience. 

We transform environments and strengthen communities through engaged collaboration, thoughtful programming, and creative design.
Our foundation is civic architecture. Our designs for transit, schools, libraries, housing, healthcare, parks and recreation facilities, and police and fire stations enrich the urban fabric with distinctive, innovative, and inspiring buildings—positively impacting countless residents.  We provide architecture, interior architecture, urban design, and planning services. 

Over time, our work has grown in scale and complexity, but our role in all of our projects has remained consistent. We are both architects and advocates of each project—facilitating the complex exchanges between communities, professionals, and government officials required to identify, amplify, and implement the project’s vision. Dattner Architects has  a well-earned reputation for delivering complex, public projects, and we are actively working with the SCA, DDC, CUNY, DASNY, NYCHA, MTA, PANYNJ, NYS Parks, and the General Services Administration.

Across the five boroughs and the region beyond, our work has had a significant role in the transformation of each place’s urban fabric, contributing to our vision of what cities can be. Having worked with numerous public agencies, we have helped to design, revitalize, and expand urban schools, infrastructure, housing, and parks in many diverse neighborhoods. Our projects have been recognized with Design Excellence Awards from the NYC Public Design Commission and numerous other organizations including American Institute of Architects; Boston Society of Architects; Municipal Art Society; New York Landmarks Conservancy; Urban Land Institute; Society of American Registered Architects; and The Architects Newspaper.

As architects we see ourselves as stewards of the built environment, we have a long-standing commitment to sustainable design characterized by a responsive, project-specific approach that combines passive and low-tech solutions with more active systems, analysis, and controls. With each new commission, we seek to push beyond the conventional standards for sustainability, innovating high-performance low-carbon approaches that work with the building program, site, and budget.

rows.business_description:
ACT is a Structured Day Program, specializing for people who are physically frail, socially isolated, have Alzheimer’s/Dementia or other cognitive related disorders.

ACT is based on the philosophy that each individual has a need and capacity for socialization and that being involved in community care helps prevent depression, loneliness, hospitalizations, and premature institutionalization.

ACT is a structured day program designed to provide meaningful, therapeutic, and age-appropriate activities for participants. ACT provides caregivers with respite and helps to alleviate some of the Care Giver’s daily responsibilities. The ACT program is therapeutic and helps to support families in their caregiving efforts.

Our goal is to provide a welcoming, home-like setting with warm, friendly, well-trained staff and volunteers who support the functioning of each participant. ACT’s goal is to improve or maintain skills and abilities, and to provide a safe environment that recognizes the dignity of each participant.

ACT program is developed for participants to be able to use community-based services to exercise their right to person-centered care.  ACT understands that our member’s personal choice is important, and we encourage the right for each person to be able to achieve their individualized goals.

Some services that ACT provides and is not limited to are:

Structured Day Program, Respite Care, ADL Care, Supervision, Case Management, Service Coordination, Education, Caregiver Support Groups
